answer_1.quote: We curate ExFunTube, a dataset consisting of 10,136 user-generated, funny short-form videos. Each video is annotated with timestamps and explanations of funny moments.
answer_1.outputs: explanations of funny moments in videos

answer_2.quote: we evaluate explanations using two model-based scores: SentBERT Score and ROSCOE.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we employ 10 AMT workers using the same criteria as in the dataset annotation but excluding the ones who already participated in the annotation.
answer_4.guideline: workers are asked to rate each explanation according to No (0), Weak No (0.25), Neutral (0.5), Weak Yes (0.75), and Yes (1) and check any shortcomings. For the comparison, workers compare GPT-3.5 with our prompting to (1) Text-only GPT-3.5, (2) MAF, and (3) Gold explanations and choose the better explanation.
